# nb1 v0.1.2

Local blink(1) control for people, applications and agents. English is the default; Chinese guides are under ./zh/. This site documents released core 88fc2be8326c076b6f09932054b0c8f11d89c0a0. Upcoming v0.1.3 device-selection behavior is explicitly marked as a preview, not a published download.

Preview is optional; explicit Play/run validates directly. Action expresses intent; Sequence/Step expresses targets and timing. Keep the original Job ID and endpoint after an uncertain response and query that ID without automatic resubmission. Host Patterns and named colors live on the computer; native device memory is separate.

## Read

- [Install](./install): verified release downloads, optional Homebrew and user services.
- [Get started](./getting-started): native CLI/server and explicit direct mode.
- [API](./api-v1): required fields, defaults, limits, errors and recovery.
- [Raw API Markdown](./source/docs/api-v1.md.txt): original machine-readable text.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](./api-v1.openapi.json): exact released HTTP schema.
- [Agents](./agents): matching MCP binary, twelve tools and the Skill.
- [Notifications](./agent-notifications): opt-in examples, preview by default.
- [Browser tools](./browser): public WebHID development preview, experimental Chrome extension and ownership handoff.
- [Support](./support): system requirements and independently scoped physical evidence.
- [Chinese API](./zh/api-v1): translated explanations with identical identifiers.
- [Source record](./site-info.json): document/build identity.

MCP uses official Go SDK stdio JSON-RPC and daemon HTTP, not a CLI subprocess or separate USB owner. The notification helper deliberately uses the CLI. Reading a Skill or this site installs nothing, starts no daemon, enables no hook and requests no hardware permissions. This static site does not control a lamp.

Current API v1 rejects a new Job on a busy device. New source libraries, Trigger routing, queues/preemption, Windows automatic services and full device-native deployment are planned, not current API operations. Software checks do not qualify other-platform physical USB or MK3.

Device selection: released v0.1.2 requires an explicit/preferred CLI serial when multiple devices are configured. Upcoming v0.1.3 sorts serials and chooses the first cached-online device, or first configured serial when none is online. Explicit positional > --device > NB1_DEVICE > profile. A chosen target never falls back to another light after failure/busy/unknown outcomes. HTTP/MCP still require serial; preview does not choose a default. The embedded Workbench keeps its current target across refresh/language changes and never automatically resubmits an unknown Job. See ./getting-started#choose-among-several-lights.
